Privacy Policy
Last updated July 12, 2026

VortexPro does not transfer any personal data.
Several of VortexPro's functionalities require the user's browser to make an external request to klingri.github.io/VortexPro/, a VortexPro-owned domain. Data sent and received from klingri.github.io/VortexPro/ contains no personally identifiable information.

VortexPro may locally store some user data in the user's browser, such as sensitive cookies from usage of a necessary feature, and it will never be transferred outside of the user's browser.

VortexPro's servers and website operate on Github. Github's privacy policy applies: https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement

Permissions we use
://*.playvortex.io/*
Allows VortexPro to access Vortex APIs in the background on behalf of the user and access cookies when paired with the optional Cookies permission

*://*.klingri.github.io/VortexPro/*
Allows VortexPro to access Vortex and VortexPro APIs in the background on behalf of the user

Storage
Allows VortexPro to access and store data. VortexPro uses it to store feature values and data associated with features

Web Request API
Allows VortexPro to analyze web traffic. VortexPro only uses it to change 404 redirects of some pages with some features enabled

Declarative Net Request API
Allows VortexPro to modify some web traffic. VortexPro only uses it to access APIs that are only accessible through the Vortex app

Alarms
Allows VortexPro to schedule background tasks

Permissions we may request
Cookies
Allows VortexPro to modify and read playvortex.io cookies. VortexPro only uses it when a necessary feature is enabled to switch accounts and store account session tokens

Notifications
Allows VortexPro to notify you of new and updated trade requests, start up, connection activity, and new community shouts
